dial.summary: BTC remains spot-driven with funding at 0.0100% per 8h (still well below 0.04% overheating threshold); BTC.D at 59.4% shows no imminent alt rotation risk; Global M2 still expanding at $103.7T (Aug 2026 G4 aggregate, latest available); real yields eased modestly to 2.78% (Oct 15) from 2.84% but remain above the 2% headwind threshold; DXY 101.78 stays above 100; FOMC Oct 28 rate decision (25bp hike to 4.00–4.25% widely expected post back-to-back CPI/PPI shocks) is the dominant near-term catalyst — dial holds BTC Accumulation until sustained BTC.D break below 55% or a Fed pivot shifts the macro backdrop.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.66T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; 4-week trend UP: July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, up 5.7% YoY, 28th consecutive monthly increase); September G4 aggregate still unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October PMI not yet available — next ISM release early November 2026; status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.78 (Oct 16, 2026 close per Trading Economics); Trading Economics confirms dollar strengthened ~1.53% over the past month (Sep 18 → Oct 16, 4-week trend UP); 52-week range 95.55–102.94 (Investing.com); Oct 18 is Sunday with no new market data; status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 decision is next major catalyst — a 25bp hike to 4.00–4.25% would likely extend DXY toward 103+.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.78% as of October 15, 2026 (FRED; down from 2.88% on Oct 13 and 2.84% on Oct 14); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 15 to 2.78% (+26bps); nominal 10-year dipped to ~5.09% on Oct 16 (from 5.19% Oct 14), driving partial relief in real yields; status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and above 2% threshold); next FRED DFII10 publication October 19, 2026.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 16, 2026: US 10yr ~5.09%, 2yr ~4.74% (par curve via Trading Economics/StockMarketWatch) → 2s10s spread ~+35bps; 4-week trend DOWN (Sep 15 ~+42bps → Oct 16 +35bps = −7bps flattening); status neutral — curve remains positively sloped (not a headwind) but is still flattening (not supportive); Oct 18 is Sunday with no new market session; FOMC Oct 28 25bp hike would push front end higher and compress spread further.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,755,639M ($6.756T) for week ending October 14, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 15, 2026; prior week Oct 7 = $6,747,560M, +$8,079M WoW); 4-week trend flat: Sep 16 $6,746,548M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M = +$9,091M (+0.13%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau — Reserve Management Purchases offsetting MBS runoff); next H.4.1 release October 22, 2026 (covers week ending Oct 21).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0100% as of October 16, 2026 7pm ET (Tokenpost/Pluang snapshot; longs paying shorts, open interest $7.74B, long accounts at 63.3%); 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to 0.0100% on Oct 16; rate remains well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; status supportive (spot-driven accumulation confirmed, no speculative leverage excess).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$302.5–303B (DefiLlama Oct 17 / Stablecoin Beat Oct 15) vs total crypto ~$2.71T (TV-Hub Oct 15, BTC.D 59.4%) → dominance ~11.2%; 30-day trend UP (Sep 17 est. ~10.5% → Oct 18 ~11.2%); status neutral — stablecoin dominance is rising but total crypto market cap is flat-to-slightly-lower (was ~$2.84T Oct 17; now ~$2.71T), so the headwind condition (rising dom + rising TOTAL simultaneously) is not triggered; BTC.D at 59.4% shows no sustained alt rotation.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.78% and mortgage rates elevated, continued monthly declines would underscore the drag from high financing costs on residential investment; provides incremental Q3 data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — one of the last major labor data points before the October 28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K, hot CPI (3.7% YoY), and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) backdrop heading into the meeting.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ending October 21, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases weekly H.4.1 balance sheet data (week ending Oct 21) at 4:30 PM ET; prior reading was $6.756T (Oct 14); any acceleration in asset runoff ahead of the Oct 28 FOMC meeting would be notable.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released four days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.
